news.analysis: Lawrence could have had a much better day, and the game's outcome would have been different had an end-zone throw to Parker Washington been ruled a catch rather than an incompletion. The controversial play saw Washington bobble a pass before appearing to secure it and getting feet in bounds for a touchdown, but it was ruled incomplete. Still, Lawrence had his faults and seemed to succumb to the Giants' pass rush. He will look to have a better outing when he faces the Titans next Sunday.
news.contents: Trevor Lawrence completed 25-of-47 passes for 301 yards, a touchdown, and two picks in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.title: Trevor Lawrence throws for 300 yards in loss to Giants

news.contents: Jacksonville Jaguars quarterback Trevor Lawrence suffered a cut on his throwing hand during Sunday's Week 11 game against the New York Giants, Ryan O'Halloran reported, citing the CBS broadcast. Lawrence completed 10 of 16 passes for 106 yards with one interception and rushed three times for seven yards in the first half. He was the only Jaguars quarterback to attempt a pass before halftime, when Jacksonville trailed 20-6.
news.title: Trevor Lawrence Suffers Cut on Throwing Hand
